findings.title: An unreadable or non-directory policy directory is skipped silently
findings.detail: loadPolicyFragments wraps readdir of <module>/policy in try/catch and does `continue` on any error, so a policy directory that exists but cannot be read (EACCES), or a `policy` that is a regular file, drops every fragment in it without an error. Design decision 6 refuses unusable entries 'because a forbid must never be skipped silently'; no scenario covers an unreadable policy directory.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN `<srcDir>/<module>/policy` exists but cannot be read or is a regular file THEN `loadPolicyFragments` skips that module and resolves without its fragments.

findings.title: allowedActions can reject for a principal whose getters change between reads
findings.detail: allowedActions validates the principal, then probeRequest validates it again and userEntity reads `roles`/`teams` a third time. A roles getter that returns a valid array on the first two reads and a non-iterable afterwards makes `new Set(p.roles)` throw inside the async function, so allowedActions rejects. The requirement says it never rejects; no scenario covers a getter whose value changes.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the principal's `roles` getter returns a valid array on its first two reads and a number afterwards THEN `allowedActions` rejects with a TypeError.

findings.title: sampleRequest leaves out run_initiator in the invoke_llm context
findings.detail: Design decision 9 says the fixed context has `run_initiator` set to the principal. contextFor for invoke_llm does not include it. It is optional in the schema, so the request is still valid.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `run_initiator: entityRef("User", principalUid.id)` to the invoke_llm sample context.

findings.title: An unreadable or non-directory policy directory is skipped silently
findings.detail: loadPolicyFragments wraps readdir of <module>/policy in try/catch and does `continue` on any error, so a policy directory that exists but cannot be read (EACCES), or a `policy` that is a regular file, drops every fragment in it without an error. Design decision 6 refuses unusable entries 'because a forbid must never be skipped silently'; no scenario covers an unreadable policy directory.

evidence.ref: src/pdp/fragments.ts

findings.suggested_fix: WHEN `<srcDir>/<module>/policy` exists but cannot be read or is a regular file THEN `loadPolicyFragments` skips that module and resolves without its fragments.

findings.title: allowedActions can reject for a principal whose getters change between reads
findings.detail: allowedActions validates the principal, then probeRequest validates it again and userEntity reads `roles`/`teams` a third time. A roles getter that returns a valid array on the first two reads and a non-iterable afterwards makes `new Set(p.roles)` throw inside the async function, so allowedActions rejects. The requirement says it never rejects; no scenario covers a getter whose value changes.
